Selected work

Event branding · Creative direction · Marketing
Indonesian Night Market (INM) by PPIA UNSW — Creative Project Manager

INM is a flagship cultural event organised by PPIA UNSW, attracting 3,000+ attendees from students, staff, and the wider Sydney community. Known as one of the largest student-led cultural festivals at UNSW, it showcases Indonesia's cultural diversity through food, performances, games, and immersive experiences.

As Creative Project Manager for the 2026 edition themed SmaraNusa, I led end-to-end event branding and visual identity, designing digital and print assets including social media content, promotional graphics, and merchandise visuals, while working cross-functionally with fundraising and operations to ensure brand consistency across every touchpoint.

  • Developed and executed full visual identity for the SmaraNusa theme across all channels
  • Designed graphics and Reels that built community excitement leading up to the event
  • Collaborated with fundraising and operations teams on brand consistency across stalls and merchandise
  • Led media partnership outreach to expand the event's reach beyond campus
